name: Home Run Stars
summary:
# Step Up to the Plate and Experience Baseball Like Never Before!

Put on your VR headset, step into the batter's box, and feel the excitement of every pitch. Swing naturally, time your hits perfectly, and launch towering home runs in an immersive baseball experience.

## Features

**⚾ Realistic VR Batting**
Experience intuitive 1:1 motion tracking that lets you swing the bat just like you would on a real baseball field.
